title: Microsoft Teams: External group chat policy enforcements for max two orgs
description: Facilitate creation and maintenance of external group chats with bilateral policy enforcement where members in the chat can belong to a maximum of two tenants.  Allow tenant admins to control bilateral chat policy and apply it to users and groups.
